installation.en: Use a complete generated plugin through a Claude Code plugin entrypoint after that route has passed installation acceptance. The source template and its repository marketplace reference are not an installable release; this route is still awaiting a real installation test.
installation.zhCN: 完整生成包应通过 Claude Code 插件入口安装，待该入口完成实装验收后再提供给用户。源码模板及指向模板的仓库 marketplace 条目不是可安装版本；此路线仍待真实安装验证。

installation.en: Use a complete generated plugin through a Codex plugin entrypoint after that route has passed installation acceptance. The source template and its repository marketplace reference are not an installable release; this route is still awaiting a real installation test.
installation.zhCN: 完整生成包应通过 Codex 插件入口安装，待该入口完成实装验收后再提供给用户。源码模板及指向模板的仓库 marketplace 条目不是可安装版本；此路线仍待真实安装验证。

installation.en: Copy the complete Skill folder into project .cursor/skills/ or .agents/skills/, then start a new Agent chat. If that session can read webpages or make HTTP requests, the Skill uses its HTTP fallback directly; a separate MCP connection is optional.
installation.zhCN: 将完整 Skill 文件夹放入项目 .cursor/skills/ 或 .agents/skills/，再新建 Agent 会话。该会话能读取网页或发起 HTTP 请求时，Skill 可直接使用 HTTP fallback；MCP 连接可选。

installation.en: Add the Streamable HTTP MCP URL using Cursor MCP settings or a verified install link. MCP tools alone do not install the Skill.
installation.zhCN: 在 Cursor MCP 设置或经验证的安装链接中添加 Streamable HTTP MCP 地址；添加工具本身不会安装 Skill。

installation.en: Import the complete Skill folder or ZIP using Settings → Skills, then start a new agent/session. If that session can read webpages or make HTTP requests, the Skill uses its HTTP fallback directly; a separate MCP connection is optional. Confirm the installed version and session capabilities during acceptance.
installation.zhCN: 通过设置 → Skills 导入完整 Skill 文件夹或 ZIP，再新建 agent/会话。该会话能读取网页或发起 HTTP 请求时，Skill 可直接使用 HTTP fallback；MCP 连接可选。验收时核实所装版本和会话能力。

installation.en: In Settings → MCP → Add, use the Streamable HTTP URL and enable it for the active agent/session. MCP tools alone do not install the Skill.
installation.zhCN: 在设置 → MCP → 添加中使用 Streamable HTTP 地址，并对当前 agent/会话启用；添加工具本身不会安装 Skill。
